impact: A messy launch for the biggest AI IPO risks denting AI sentiment; GOOGL and AMZN own stakes, and the pricing will set a marker for AI infrastructure names like NBIS.
summary: Reuters reports Anthropic emailed bankers IPO details late Monday showing about 867M shares at $70 to $80 each, a raise of up to about $69B, then retracted them saying the pricing details were inaccurate and would be updated. The roadshow was expected to start Tuesday, with trading targeted around Nov 19-20.
title: Anthropic sends, then retracts IPO terms: 867M shares at $70-$80
